text:
maria_ops: Heads up — provisioning new GCP project for eu-west4 dedicated fleet (project redwood-eu-prod-priv-01). I hit GPU quota limits while trying to create A100 nodes, opening a support case now.

maria_ops: Case opened: 2026-05-05 09:12 UTC — GCP Case 1187654321. Request payload: +16 x A100 GPUs in eu-west4, +160 vCPUs, +50 external static IPs. Asked to allow a2-highgpu family and increase region accelerator quota. Justification: Dedicated inference fleet for customer pilot, 8 A100 per node, target 16 concurrent nodes for initial rollout.

ajay_infra: Can you paste the project/org/billing IDs? Support will ask for billing and org verification.

maria_ops: Project: redwood-eu-prod-priv-01; Org: organizations/512345678901; Billing account: B012-34567-89. Finance approval exists — attached to the case as 'finance-approval-2026-05-04.pdf'.

mei_oncall: Noted. Label this P2 (blocking rollout) and request quota team escalation if no update within 24h. Also ask them to validate physical capacity for A100 in eu-west4.

maria_ops: Pasting support reply I just received by email: "Anna (GCP Support): We've created an internal PR to request the GPU quota increase. Case#1187654321. Estimated time 48-72h for final approval. Request ID: req-3a9f4b2c. Please provide sustained usage profile and whether you can accept alternative regions or GPU types."

ajay_infra: Can you paste the exact gcloud command and the error you hit so I can reproduce locally?

maria_ops: Error when creating instance: ```
gcloud compute instances create gpu-node-01 --zone=eu-west4-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --project=redwood-eu-prod-priv-01
ERROR: Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded. Requested 1, available 0
```

ajay_infra: OK. I'll DM Anna and ask for technical escalation and a direct point of contact. Also check forwarding-rule and external IP quotas — our canary LB needs 8 static IPs.

sylvia_platform: FYI cost rough estimate: 16 A100 nodes (~p99 config) ≈ $240k/mo on-demand. If we run sustained reserved or committed use it drops ~30%. Finance wants confirmation whether we'll use sustained or committed.

maria_ops: Finance confirmed they will support committed spend if we can lock by end of quarter, linked in the ticket. @GCP Support — please expedite; pilot launch scheduled next Tue and this quota is blocking.

GCP Support: (email posted) "Anna (GCP Support): Tracking Case 1187654321. I've escalated to the quota team and requested region capacity validation. Could you share expected sustained monthly GPU hours and whether you can accept equivalent GPUs in neighbouring regions (eu-west1/eu-west2) as a contingency? ETA for next status: 24-48h."

mei_oncall: If they offer other regions, check latency to our EU data store. eu-west4 chosen for data residency — avoid accepting regions that break residency.

ajay_infra: Action items: 1) maria — upload sustained usage doc to the case (done). 2) ajay — follow up with Anna at 12:30 CET tomorrow and request escalation if no progress. 3) mei — draft fallback scheduling (cross-region) playbook. 4) sylvia — confirm committed spend numbers and post link here. I'll update thread when support gives an ETA. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: Follow-up: support asked for org policy link and a sample deployment manifest showing node counts; I've just attached both to Case 1187654321.

ajay_infra: bumped — I'll ping Anna and post any reply here. If we don't get capacity, next step is to schedule a short call with quota team and our account rep.
